material.acceptance_criteria: A CI browser job where two peers join the same chosen room and both report it in the status panel.
material.description: The client page offers a room name entry and list, and two peers can enter the same chosen room from the UI; js/client/play.js reads location.hash with default lobby.
material.subject: Client room choice is only a URL hash with a default lobby
material.witness: CI run 39078459424 on f8ab064: job 'browser host and browser peer over wireweave' prints 'browser room select ok room=ci-room-39078459424 first=true second=true'; lobby room panel job success. Witness-log line appended.
